sentences.en: Rain formed pools in the hollow spaces on the rocks.
sentences.zh: 雨水在岩石上的凹陷处形成了水坑。

sentences.en: The stars twinkled over the pointed firs in the hollow.
sentences.zh: 星星在山谷中的尖塔上方闪烁。

sentences.en: Yanni still had that weird hollow look on his face.
sentences.zh: 杨尼的脸色仍然带着那种奇怪的空洞表情。

senses.zh: 空的；凹的；虚伪的；中空的，空腹的 -
